'''Natsuki Yoshihara''' (Japanese: '''吉原ナツキ''' ''Yoshihara Natsuki'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Yoshihara was born sometime on August 14 in {{wp|Hokkaido}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She began to provide voices for Pokémon starting in {{aniseries|RS}}. Her most prominent roles are that of [[Ash's Taillow]], [[Brock's Mudkip]] (only for a short time during [[Megumi Hayashibara]]'s maternity leave), and [[James's Chimecho]].
